unemployment.name: Unemployment Rate
unemployment.description: Central Coast unemployment rate (small area estimate).
unemployment.contextNarrative: Unemployment on the Central Coast tends to track RBA monetary policy decisions with a 3–6 month lag. Rising interest rates dampen business investment and hiring; falling rates stimulate employment recovery.

labour_participation.name: Labour Force Participation Rate
labour_participation.description: Share of working-age population actively employed or seeking work.

employment_pop_ratio.name: Employment-to-Population Ratio
employment_pop_ratio.description: Proportion of the working-age population who are employed.

jobseeker.name: JobSeeker Recipients
jobseeker.description: Number of Central Coast residents receiving JobSeeker payments.
jobseeker.contextNarrative: JobSeeker recipient numbers are a leading indicator of labour market stress, often rising before the headline unemployment rate. Nationally, recipient volumes tracked sharply during COVID-19 and tapered as the RBA tightened monetary policy from May 2022.

job_vacancies.name: Job Vacancies (Internet)
job_vacancies.description: Online job vacancy index — proxy for employer demand on the Coast.

business_confidence_cc.name: CC Business Confidence
business_confidence_cc.contextNarrative: CC business confidence is benchmarked against the NSW state average. The Coast tends to outperform NSW during periods of remote-work driven population growth but underperforms when construction activity softens.

house_price.name: Average House Price
house_price.description: Average Central Coast house sale price.
house_price.contextNarrative: House prices on the Central Coast are highly sensitive to interest rate cycles, typically with a 3–6 month lag after RBA decisions. The 2022–23 rate hiking cycle caused a significant price correction; the subsequent stabilisation reflects constrained supply against persistent demand.

house_price_yoy.name: House Price Growth (YoY)
house_price_yoy.description: Annual change in Central Coast average house price.

house_rent.name: Average Weekly Rent
house_rent.description: Average asking rent per week for houses on the Central Coast.
house_rent.contextNarrative: Rental affordability is a key liveability indicator for the Coast. Vacancy rates below 1% create upward pressure on rents; this has persisted since 2021 driven by sea-change migration and constrained supply.

vacancy_rate.name: Residential Vacancy Rate
vacancy_rate.description: Proportion of residential dwellings that are vacant.

building_approvals_n.name: Building Approvals (count)
building_approvals_n.description: Number of new house building approvals in the Central Coast LGA.
building_approvals_n.contextNarrative: Construction approvals are a forward indicator of housing supply. Higher interest rates raise borrowing costs for developers and buyers, dampening approval volumes with a typical 2–4 month lag after rate changes.

building_approvals_v.name: Building Approvals (value $000)
building_approvals_v.description: Total value of new house building approvals (thousands AUD).

avg_mortgage_rate.name: Average Mortgage Rate
avg_mortgage_rate.description: National average outstanding mortgage rate across all institutions.

cra_recipients.name: Commonwealth Rent Assistance Recipients
cra_recipients.description: Central Coast residents receiving Commonwealth Rent Assistance.
cra_recipients.contextNarrative: Rising CRA recipient numbers signal growing housing affordability stress. On the Central Coast, CRA recipients increased markedly post-2021 as sea-change migration drove rents above affordability thresholds for lower-income residents.

retail_total.name: Total Retail Spend
retail_total.description: Total retail card spend index for the Central Coast.
retail_total.contextNarrative: Retail spend reflects consumer confidence and purchasing power. Higher interest rates reduce discretionary spending as mortgage repayments rise. Central Coast retail is bolstered by visitor spending during peak tourism seasons.

retail_tourism.name: Tourism & Entertainment Spend
retail_tourism.description: Tourism and entertainment card spend index — visitor economy proxy.

airbnb_revenue.name: Short-Term Rental Gross Revenue
airbnb_revenue.description: Total gross revenue across all active STRA listings on the Coast.
airbnb_revenue.contextNarrative: Short-term rental revenue is a sensitive indicator of visitor economy health. The Central Coast STRA market surged during COVID-19 domestic travel restrictions (2020–21) and has since moderated as international travel resumed. Oil price movements influence drive-market visitor volumes.

vehicles_total.name: Total New Vehicle Registrations
vehicles_total.description: New vehicle registrations in the Central Coast LGA.
vehicles_total.contextNarrative: New vehicle registrations track consumer confidence and business fleet renewal cycles. Oil price movements influence the mix between conventional and electric vehicles, with a typical 1–2 month lag between a price signal and observable registration behaviour.

vehicles_private.name: Private Vehicle Registrations
vehicles_private.description: New private vehicle registrations in the Central Coast LGA.

vehicles_business.name: Business Vehicle Registrations
vehicles_business.description: New business vehicle registrations in the Central Coast LGA.

cash_rate.name: RBA Cash Rate Target
cash_rate.description: Reserve Bank of Australia official cash rate target.
cash_rate.contextNarrative: The RBA cash rate is the primary lever of Australian monetary policy. Rate decisions flow through to mortgage rates, business lending, consumer confidence, and asset prices — all with varying lags. The 2022–23 hiking cycle (from 0.10% to 4.35%) was the most aggressive in three decades.

cpi_yoy.name: CPI Inflation (YoY)
cpi_yoy.description: Australian CPI annual inflation rate (monthly indicator).
cpi_yoy.contextNarrative: Inflation peaked at 8.4% in December 2022 and has since moderated toward the RBA's 2–3% target band. Persistently elevated services inflation — driven partly by housing costs — has delayed rate cuts.

us_fed_rate.name: US Federal Funds Rate
us_fed_rate.description: US Federal Reserve target funds rate.
us_fed_rate.contextNarrative: The US Fed rate anchors global risk-free rates. RBA decisions are influenced by — but not mechanically linked to — Fed moves. AUD/USD and Australian bond yields are sensitive to Fed signals.

bond_yield_10yr.name: AU 10-Year Bond Yield
bond_yield_10yr.description: Australian 10-year government bond yield — long-term rate benchmark.

rba_twi.name: AUD Trade-Weighted Index
rba_twi.description: RBA trade-weighted index — overall AUD exchange rate against trading partners.

aud_usd.name: AUD/USD Exchange Rate
aud_usd.description: Australian dollar / US dollar exchange rate.
aud_usd.contextNarrative: The AUD is a commodity currency — closely linked to iron ore, coal, and LNG prices. A weaker AUD raises import prices (including fuel), feeds into domestic inflation, and affects the purchasing power of international tourists visiting the Central Coast.

oil_price.name: Oil Price (Brent, USD/bbl)
oil_price.description: Brent crude oil price (USD per barrel).
oil_price.contextNarrative: Oil prices are the primary global driver of fuel costs, affecting both transport costs for businesses and the relative economics of EV adoption. Higher oil prices accelerate EV uptake with an observable 1–2 month lag in new registration data.

iron_ore.name: Iron Ore Spot Price
iron_ore.description: Iron ore spot price (USD per tonne) — key Australian export commodity.

crb_index.name: CRB Commodity Index
crb_index.description: Thomson Reuters / CoreCommodity CRB index — broad commodities benchmark.

bulk_commodities.name: RBA Bulk Commodities Index (AUD)
bulk_commodities.description: RBA bulk commodities index in AUD — coal, iron ore, LNG.

asx200.name: ASX 200
asx200.description: ASX 200 index month-end close — Australian equities benchmark.
asx200.contextNarrative: Equity markets reflect aggregate expectations about economic growth, corporate earnings, and monetary policy. Rising rates typically compress equity valuations; the ASX 200 is also sensitive to commodity prices given the heavy resource-sector weighting.

airbnb_adr.name: STRA Average Daily Rate (ADR)
airbnb_adr.description: Average daily rate across active short-term rental listings on the Central Coast.
airbnb_adr.contextNarrative: ADR measures the average nightly price achieved by STRA listings. Seasonal peaks in January and Easter reflect holiday demand. Long-run ADR growth reflects both inflation and rising demand for Coast accommodation from Sydney day-trippers and holiday makers.

unit_price.name: Average Unit Price
unit_price.description: Average Central Coast unit/apartment sale price.
unit_price.contextNarrative: Unit prices on the Central Coast respond to the same interest rate cycle as house prices but with different supply dynamics. Units provide a more affordable entry point and are sensitive to investor demand, which is heavily influenced by mortgage rates.
